items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Milt Jackson was in the band... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I know.

ctx.x: Yeah, that fast moving line. They had a lot of imitators, but it didn't sound as good as they did.

I heard, for the first time last night, on the broadcast also, the band that Dizzy took out to Billy Berg's in 1945 or '46. Forty-five, I think it was. Charlie Parker, and Milt Jackson was in the band. And this was a broadcast. And, oh, gee, it was really -- it really was mind-blowing to hear that band after all these years, because I've talked to Dizzy a lot about it and Ray Brown and Milt Jackson, but it never recorded. And then to finally hear it as I'm driving, and it's a broadcast, it really was a trip.
